name: Tethers
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level bloodrager 2, magus 2, summoner 2, unchained summoner 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a rope)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell causes a multitude of ropes burst forth from the ground and wrap up any creature in the area.

Every creature within the area of the spell is the target of a combat maneuver check made to grapple each round at the beginning of your turn, including the round that tethers is cast. Creatures that enter the area of effect are also automatically attacked. The ropes do not provoke attacks of opportunity. When determining the ropes’ CMB, they use your caster level as their base attack bonus and add your spellcasting ability modifier. Roll only once for the entire spell effect each round and apply the result to all creatures in the area of effect.

The ropes do not deal damage to creatures they have grappled, but they will attempt to pin any creature currently grappled. The CMD of the tethers, for the purposes of escaping the grapple, is equal to 10 + its CMB.

The ropes created by this spell cannot be damaged as they are instantly replaced by more ropes, but they can be dispelled as normal. The entire area of effect is considered difficult terrain while the spell lasts.
